dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: Take your time to go through whatever you need... But check with your captain or the Liaison Officer first. Then list everything clearly, one by one.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You look like you're really busy?

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: I'm doing alright. Thanks for asking!

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: I'm currently managing Logistics Company's supply operations at Dornman Port on behalf of Captain Hertha.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: Although I've been learning the ropes from Captain Hertha for a while now, now that I'm handling things on my own, I'm thinking I could really use a second pair of hands... or three.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: Makes me wonder if Captain Hertha actually hit the ground running doing this back in the day...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of supplies do you deal with?

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: Logistics Company primarily supplies combat gear, consumables, and general provisions...

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: Food and drink are classified under the general provisions category. We've divided these into two main types: the traditional dry stores and the new canned rations that are sourced through a tender by Logistics Company.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: The dry stores come packed in wooden crates. They consist mainly of hardtack, jerky, and dried beans. If you don't want to chew on these all day long, you'd better throw them all into a pot and make a soup or stew outta them.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: The canned rations come in several different menus. Personally, I'd go with the meat stew, mashed potatoes, and Valberry jam combo.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: You've got to make sure you have enough potable water or your standard-issue water purification agents on hand though. Otherwise, you'd be drinking brine...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, when I need something, how do I go about putting in a request?

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: #Allow me to explain, Commander {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: First, the knight should identify the item or items they're in need of. Once that's done, they have to fill out a request form with their name, unit, company, and service number.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: Next, and this is the most important part, they have to take this form to their Company Captain, or at least the Liaison Officer, to get a sign-off on the request. Only when we see the sign-off do we then issue the requested supplies.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: Typically, individual requests do not come to me directly. Instead, they're consolidated at the unit level and then passed on to me.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: But every now and then, someone tries to cut corners and bypass the system. That's a real headache for me.

choices.text: Maybe they had some sort of emergency?

response.speaker: Glenfidia
response.text: I get that. In the field, sticking strictly to established procedures is too rigid and can cause one to miss out on windows of opportunity.

response.speaker: Glenfidia
response.text: But now that we're back at Dornman Port, and things are a lot less frantic down here, we should really try to stick to the standard procedures.

choices.text: Maybe they didn't want to wait too long?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about we take a break and have a couple of drinks?

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: Thanks for asking! I really should be the one making drinks for you.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: I wouldn't be doing justice to the "Cocktail Knight" title you gave me otherwise...

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: But I can't leave right now as I'm still on duty...

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: But once I'm done here, I'll be sure to make a delicious drink for you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shan't disturb you any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: Ah, please excuse me. I'd totally spare you more time if I could. Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: Please supply full details of any requests you may have... Ah, this fragrance. It's truly refreshing...
